newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street shares expected to gain at open.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street shares expected to gain at open.

text.p: Wall Street shares are expected to extend gains at the open on Thursday, garnering upward momentum from yesterday's stock market rally, a lower interest rate environment and a strong technology sector.
"We are on a roll," Michael Metz, chief investment strategist at Oppenheimer & Co said. "The bond market is behaving a bit better...it is looking for an excuse to rally."

Bonds gained 8/32 to yield 6.46 percent, after weekly jobless claims rose to 300,000 for the week ended August 2 compared with a revised rise of 275,000 in the prior week. Standard & Poor's 500 futures rose 3.80 points to 967.40.
